query: What does the July 2026 medRxiv preprint on bivalent RSVpreF (Abrysvo) vaccine effectiveness across three RSV seasons report for adults ≥60 years, and which estimates remain provisional?

correct_answer: VE ~80%/70%/51% seasons 1–3; third-season CI includes null; adults ≥60 KPSC.
Third-season estimate provisional; no independent replication yet.

pubmed.title: Bivalent RSVpreF effectiveness across three RSV seasons (medRxiv preprint)
pubmed.summary: This medRxiv preprint (not peer-reviewed) reports adjusted vaccine effectiveness of bivalent RSVpreF (Abrysvo) against RSV-related LRTD hospitalisation/ED visits in adults ≥60 years of 80% (95% CI 68–87), 70% (53–81), and 51% (−12–78) in seasons one, two, and three after vaccination at Kaiser Permanente Southern California.
